Improper Handling of Case Sensitivity vulnerability in Erlang/OTP inets httpd allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to read files inside a mod_auth protected directory by requesting them with different casing, on deployments whose filesystem is case-insensitive.

mod_auth:secret_path/3 decides whether a resolved filesystem path lies inside a protected directory block by running the configured directory path through re:run/3 without the caseless option. A request for /secret/file against a directory configured as /Secret therefore does not match, so the request is treated as unprotected and no authentication challenge is issued, while the filesystem resolves the differently cased path to the same file and mod_get serves it. Deployments on case-sensitive filesystems are unaffected, because there the filesystem itself rejects the mismatched casing.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.17, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.6, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.6, corresponding to inets from 5.10 before 9.3.2.7, from 9.4 before 9.6.2.3, and from 9.7 before 9.7.2. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to inets before 5.10, is affected is unknown.

Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input vulnerability in Erlang/OTP inets httpc allows a malicious or compromised HTTP server to degrade availability by returning a numeric header whose value is a very long run of digits.

httpc_handler.erl converts the server-supplied Content-Length with list_to_integer/1 before comparing it against max_body_size, so the size check cannot protect the conversion, and the option defaults to nolimit in any case. The same unbounded conversion appears in httpc_response:format_response/1 for Content-Length and in httpc_response:get_ms_from_retry_after/1 for Retry-After, which is guarded only by a check that the first character is a digit. A value of up to roughly 1.26 million digits converts successfully and costs the requesting process hundreds of milliseconds of arbitrary-precision arithmetic per response. The conversion function is documented to accept integers of any size, so bounding the input is the caller's responsibility.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.17, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.6, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.6, corresponding to inets from 5.10 before 9.3.2.7, from 9.4 before 9.6.2.3, and from 9.7 before 9.7.2. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to inets before 5.10, is affected is unknown.

Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime vulnerability in Erlang/OTP inets httpd allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause denial of service by sending valid request headers with a large Content-Length and then stalling before the body is complete.

httpd_request_handler:handle_info/2 cancels the request timeout as soon as a parse step succeeds, which includes the headers, and the clause that handles a decoder asking for more data re-arms the socket with {active, once} without setting any further timer. httpd_request:whole_body/2 returns such a continuation whenever the bytes received are fewer than the announced Content-Length, so a well-formed request that stops mid-body leaves the worker waiting indefinitely. The periodic byte-rate check that would reclaim it is armed only when minimum_bytes_per_second is configured, which it is not by default. Repeating this across connections occupies every worker permitted by max_clients and denies service to legitimate clients at negligible bandwidth cost.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.17, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.6, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.6, corresponding to inets from 5.10 before 9.3.2.7, from 9.4 before 9.6.2.3, and from 9.7 before 9.7.2. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to inets before 5.10, is affected is unknown.

Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input vulnerability in Erlang/OTP eldap allows a malicious or compromised LDAP server to degrade availability by returning a referral URL whose port component is a very long run of digits.

eldap:parse_port/2 passes the port substring straight to list_to_integer/1 with no length bound. The surrounding try ... catch only rejects a value that fails to parse, so a syntactically valid port of up to roughly 1.26 million digits converts successfully and costs the caller hundreds of milliseconds of arbitrary-precision arithmetic per referral. The conversion function itself is documented to accept integers of any size, so bounding the input is the caller's responsibility. Reaching the flaw requires the application to pass a server-supplied referral to eldap:parse_ldap_url/1, which eldap never calls itself: referral strings are returned to the caller unparsed.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.17, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.6, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.6, corresponding to eldap from 1.0.3 before 1.2.14.2, from 1.2.15 before 1.2.16.1, and from 1.3 before 1.3.1.

Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input vulnerability in Erlang/OTP snmp allows a remote attacker to degrade availability by sending an SNMP message containing a BER INTEGER whose length field is arbitrarily large.

snmp_pdus:dec_integer_notag/1 defaults its size limit to infinity, and do_dec_integer_notag/2 then accumulates the value across every declared byte with a recursive shift and bitwise or. Work grows superlinearly in the declared length because each operation acts on a progressively larger bignum. The size-limited variant dec_integer_notag/2 exists but is reached from only one call site, dec_snmp_version/1, which bounds the version field to ten bytes; the request identifier, error status and index, generic and specific trap fields, engine boots and time, and every varbind value decoded by dec_value/1 all use the unbounded form. The decode runs before the PDU is processed, so no valid request is required beyond what the deployment demands to accept the message at all.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.17, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.6, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.6, corresponding to snmp from 4.25.1 before 5.18.2.1, from 5.19 before 5.20.2.2, and from 5.20.3 before 5.20.5. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to snmp before 4.25.1, is affected is unknown.

Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in Erlang/OTP inets httpd allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause denial of service by opening and holding open a large number of connections. The max_clients option is documented to default to 150, and the inets hardening guide presents that limit as the first layer of denial-of-service defence, but a server that does not set it explicitly accepts an unlimited number of simultaneous connections. Establishing the connections is sufficient; no valid request and no authentication are required.

The accept gate in httpd_manager:handle_new_connection/4 reads the option with httpd_util:lookup/2, which returns undefined when the key is absent, rather than the three-argument form carrying the 150 default that the neighbouring get_ustate/2 uses. Erlang term ordering places every integer before every atom, so the Count =< Max guard holds for any connection count and the server never returns {reject, busy}. Each accepted connection occupies a worker process and a socket for as long as it is held, driving the node towards process, memory and file descriptor exhaustion. Servers that set max_clients explicitly are unaffected, because a configured value is applied as intended.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.17, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.6, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.6, corresponding to inets from 5.10 before 9.3.2.7, from 9.4 before 9.6.2.3, and from 9.7 before 9.7.2.

Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime vulnerability in Erlang/OTP inets httpd allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause denial of service by sending a request with a chunked body whose chunk-size line is not a hexadecimal number. The worker serving the connection is never released and no timeout reclaims it, so repeating the request across connections occupies every available worker and denies service to legitimate clients. No authentication is required and the default configuration is affected.

The chunk-size line must arrive in a write separate from the headers. When the body accompanies the headers, httpd_request_handler:handle_body/3 calls http_chunk:decode/3 inside a try ... catch throw:Error, so the {error, {chunk_size, _}} thrown by http_chunk:decode_size/4 is answered with 400 Bad Request. When the chunk size arrives later, the decoder is resumed through a bare catch in httpd_request_handler:handle_info/2, which converts the throw into a return value rather than raising it; the resulting error tuple is then treated as the next decoder continuation, the socket is re-armed, and the worker waits for data that never comes. The request timeout has already been cancelled at the point the headers were accepted, and the periodic byte-rate check is only armed when minimum_bytes_per_second is configured, which it is not by default.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 18.1.4 before OTP 27.3.4.17, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.6, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.6, corresponding to inets from 6.0.3 before 9.3.2.7, from 9.4 before 9.6.2.3, and from 9.7 before 9.7.2.

Path Equivalence vulnerability in Erlang/OTP inets httpd allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to read files inside a mod_auth protected directory by prefixing the request path with an extra slash.

httpd_request:validate_uri/1 normalises the request URI with uri_string:normalize/1, which performs RFC 3986 dot-segment removal but does not collapse empty path segments, so a doubled slash survives. mod_alias:real_name/3 concatenates the document root with that URI, and mod_auth:secret_path/3 then decides whether the result lies inside a protected directory block by running the configured directory path as an unanchored regular expression against it. The doubled slash breaks the contiguous substring the regex needs, so the request is treated as unprotected and no authentication challenge is issued, while mod_get opens the same path and the operating system collapses the doubled slash and returns the protected file. The same path mismatch also evades the per-path accounting in mod_security.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.17, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.6, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.6, corresponding to inets from 5.10 before 9.3.2.7, from 9.4 before 9.6.2.3, and from 9.7 before 9.7.2. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to inets before 5.10, is affected is unknown.

httpd has never implemented obs-fold (RFC 2616 §2.2 / RFC 7230 §3.2.4 header continuation lines). Every CRLF followed by a non-CRLF octet unconditionally starts a new header. This missing feature became a security concern as the understanding of HTTP request smuggling attacks evolved.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.17, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.6, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.6, corresponding to inets from 5.10 before 9.3.2.7, from 9.4 before 9.6.2.3, and from 9.7 before 9.7.2. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to inets before 5.10, is affected is unknown.

Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input vulnerability in Erlang/OTP stdlib allows a remote attacker to degrade availability by supplying a URI whose port component is a very long run of digits.

uri_string:get_port/1 passes the port substring to binary_to_integer/1 with no length bound, catching only error:badarg, so a syntactically valid port of up to roughly 1.26 million digits converts successfully and costs the calling process hundreds of milliseconds of arbitrary-precision arithmetic. The conversion is reached from every authority-parsing path in uri_string:parse/1, including the host, registered-name, and IPv4 and IPv6 forms. parse/1 is the documented interface for parsing URIs, so any application that parses an attacker-supplied URI is exposed without further configuration. The conversion function is documented to accept integers of any size, so bounding the input is the caller's responsibility.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 21.0 before OTP 27.3.4.17, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.6, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.6, corresponding to stdlib from 3.5 before 6.2.2.5, from 7.0 before 7.3.0.2, and from 8.0 before 8.0.4.

Classic buffer overflow in the Erlang/OTP megaco flex scanner C driver allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt the driver's memory (and potentially achieve remote code execution or a denial-of-service crash) by sending a single text-encoded H.248/Megaco message containing an oversized property parm name.

When tokenizing a Local/Remote descriptor, mfs_load_property_groups extracts the attacker-controlled property name (bounded only by the message length) and, when no value follows, formats it into a fixed 512-byte error_msg field of the MfsErlDrvData struct using an unchecked sprintf call. Names longer than roughly 452 bytes overflow into the immediately following struct fields (text_buf, text_ptr, term_spec, term_spec_size, term_spec_index), overwriting live pointers and counters with attacker-chosen bytes. Subsequent scanner code writes and frees through the corrupted pointers, producing arbitrary write and arbitrary free primitives inside the BEAM VM process, which can be leveraged for remote code execution. On builds compiled with _FORTIFY_SOURCE the overflow is detected at runtime and terminates the process with SIGABRT, resulting in denial of service.

The overflow occurs in the flex scanner before any grammar or Megaco-level authentication processing, so exploitation requires only network reachability to the megaco transport port on a node configured with {scanner, flex}.

This vulnerability is associated with program files lib/megaco/src/flex/megaco_flex_scanner_drv.flex.src and program routines mfs_load_property_groups.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.15, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.4, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.4, corresponding to megaco from 3.17.1 before 4.7.2.2, from 4.8 before 4.8.3.1, and from 4.9 before 4.9.1. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to megaco before 3.17.1, is affected is unknown.

Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity vulnerability in Gleam allows an adversary in the middle to substitute forged Hex package contents during dependency resolution.

During dependency resolution Gleam fetches package metadata from the signature-verified Hex repository, which covers each release's dependency requirements and SHA-256 outer_checksum. After resolving versions, gleam_cli::dependencies::lookup_package makes a second request to the unsigned Hex API through gleam_core::hex::get_package_release and records the outer_checksum and dependency names from that JSON response into manifest.toml, instead of the values from the verified repository metadata. The Hex repository signature does not cover the API response.

An adversary in the middle who can intercept TLS with a certificate trusted by the Gleam process (for example a TLS-inspecting proxy using a CA in the operating system trust store or added through GLEAM_CACERTS_PATH), and who can modify both the API release response and the corresponding repository tarball, can supply a package archive with a matching forged checksum without the Hex repository signing key. Gleam verifies the forged tarball against the forged checksum, accepts it, and extracts it as a dependency source, resulting in loss of integrity of the downloaded package contents.

Only projects that resolve or update Hex dependencies are affected, which happens when the manifest is missing, a dependency is added or updated, or dependency requirements change. Builds that reuse an unchanged, known-good manifest.toml continue to verify tarballs against its pinned checksum. This issue affects gleam: from 0.18.0 before 1.18.0.

The Erlang/OTP ssl TLS 1.2 (and earlier) and DTLS client does not verify that the cipher suite selected by the server in ServerHello was among the suites offered by the client in ClientHello. The client-side tls_handshake:hello/5 handler validates the negotiated protocol version and the downgrade sentinel but hands the server-chosen suite directly to ssl_handshake:handle_server_hello_extensions/9, which installs it without a membership check. The TLS 1.3 client path performs this check (per RFC 8446), so it is not affected.

An on-path attacker between the client and the intended server can respond with a ServerHello selecting an anonymous key exchange suite such as TLS_DH_anon_* or TLS_ECDH_anon_* that the client never offered. Anonymous suites do not require the server to present a certificate, so the entire verify_peer and cacerts configuration is bypassed: the attacker completes the handshake with its own ephemeral parameters, no certificate is validated, no hostname is checked, and ssl:connect returns {ok, Socket}. All subsequent application traffic is readable and modifiable by the attacker.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.15, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.4, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.4, corresponding to ssl from 5.3.4 before 11.2.12.11, from 11.3 before 11.6.0.4, and from 11.7 before 11.7.4. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to ssl before 5.3.4, is affected is unknown.

The Erlang/OTP httpc HTTP client does not enforce a limit on the total size of response headers received from a server. The max_header_size option defaults to nolimit, and httpc_response:parse_headers/6 accumulates every header into a list before the length check runs (which only fires after the terminating CRLF CRLF is received).

A malicious or compromised HTTP server can send an arbitrarily large number of headers, or headers with very large values, causing the client process to allocate unbounded memory until the system runs out of memory or the BEAM VM crashes. A proof-of-concept server sending 100,000 headers of roughly 4000 bytes each caused the client VM to allocate over 13 GB of memory in under 30 seconds.

Any application using httpc:request/4,5 to connect to untrusted servers is affected. No authentication is required: any server the client connects to (including via a redirect or man-in-the-middle) can trigger the exhaustion.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.17, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.6, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.6, corresponding to inets from 5.10 before 9.3.2.7, from 9.4 before 9.6.2.3, and from 9.7 before 9.7.2. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to inets before 5.10, is affected is unknown.

Improper Enforcement of Message Integrity During Transmission in a Communication Channel vulnerability in Erlang/OTP ssl (tls_gen_connection module) allows a network-positioned attacker to inject unauthenticated plaintext that the TLS client application later treats as authenticated server data.

The function tls_gen_connection:handle_protocol_record/3 rejects APPLICATION_DATA records that arrive in pre-handshake states when the TLS endpoint acts as a server, but does not apply the same check when the endpoint acts as a client. A network-positioned attacker can send plaintext APPLICATION_DATA records to the client during the handshake. The records are buffered and, once the handshake completes successfully, delivered to the application as if they were authenticated post-handshake data. The attacker cannot observe the client's response or steer the connection, so the impact is limited to blind injection of unauthenticated bytes. The injection window is wider for TLS versions prior to TLS 1.3 than for TLS 1.3.

This vulnerability is associated with program file lib/ssl/src/tls_gen_connection.erl.

TLS 1.3 is affected starting with OTP 22.0, when TLS 1.3 support was added.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.14, from OTP 28.0 before OTP 28.5.0.3, and from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.3, corresponding to ssl from 5.3.4 before 11.2.12.10, from 11.3 before 11.6.0.3, and from 11.7 before 11.7.3. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to ssl before 5.3.4, is affected is unknown.

Observable Timing Discrepancy vulnerability in Erlang/OTP ssh (ssh_auth, ssh_options modules) allows unauthenticated remote username enumeration via timing side-channel in password authentication.

When the SSH daemon is configured with the user_passwords or password option, ssh_auth:check_password/3 performs a PBKDF2-SHA256 computation with 600,000 iterations (~300ms) for valid usernames, but returns immediately (~0ms) for invalid usernames via the ssh_options:get_password_option/2 path. This timing difference is detectable in a single authentication attempt and allows an unauthenticated attacker to distinguish valid from invalid usernames.

The user_passwords and password options are documented as intended for test purposes; the recommended alternative is pwdfun, which is not affected by this vulnerability.

This vulnerability is associated with program files lib/ssh/src/ssh_auth.erl and lib/ssh/src/ssh_options.erl.

This issue affects OTP from OTP 29.0 before OTP 29.0.2, corresponding to ssh from 6.0 before 6.0.1.

Path traversal vulnerability in Gleam's dependency management allows arbitrary directory deletion via malicious build/packages/packages.toml content.

Package keys read from build/packages/packages.toml by LocalPackages::read_from_disc are passed without validation to paths.build_packages_package(), which constructs a filesystem path by joining the project build directory with the attacker-controlled key. The resulting path is then passed to fs::delete_directory (which calls remove_dir_all). No check is performed to ensure the path remains within the intended build/packages/ directory. Both absolute paths and relative traversal sequences (e.g. ../) are accepted as package keys, allowing deletion of arbitrary directories.

An attacker who can cause a victim to run gleam deps download on a project containing a malicious build/packages/packages.toml (e.g. by committing the normally-gitignored file to a repository) can cause arbitrary directories on the victim's system to be recursively deleted.

This issue affects Gleam from 0.18.0-rc1 until 1.17.0.

Symlink following vulnerability in Gleam's Hex package export allows files outside the project root to be embedded in the generated package tarball.

The file collection helpers (gleam_files, native_files, private_files) in compiler-cli/src/fs.rs use follow_links(true) when walking publishable directories such as src/ and priv/. The collected paths are added to the package archive via add_path_to_tar in compiler-cli/src/publish.rs without verifying that the resolved target remains within the project root. A symlink placed under a publishable directory will cause gleam export hex-tarball or gleam publish to embed the contents of the symlink target into the generated Hex package.

An attacker with write access to the project repository can place a symlink in src/ or priv/ pointing to an arbitrary file. When a maintainer or CI pipeline runs gleam publish or gleam export hex-tarball, local files readable by the publisher (such as secrets, tokens, or SSH keys) are silently embedded into the published package artifact.

This issue affects Gleam from 0.10.0-rc1 until 1.17.0.

Path traversal vulnerability in Gleam's handling of custom documentation pages allows arbitrary file read and file write outside the intended documentation output directory.

The documentation.pages entries from gleam.toml are incorporated into filesystem paths without sufficient validation or confinement to the intended project and documentation output directories. The documentation.pages[].path field can be used to write generated documentation files outside the intended build/dev/docs/<package>/ output directory. The documentation.pages[].source field can be used to read files outside the project directory and embed their contents into generated documentation output.

An attacker who can convince a victim to run gleam docs build on an untrusted project, or with untrusted gleam.toml content, can cause local files readable by the victim to be included in generated documentation artifacts, and can cause generated documentation files to be written outside the intended docs output directory.

This issue affects Gleam from 1.16.0 until 1.17.0.

Improper path validation vulnerability in the Gleam compiler's handling of git dependencies allows arbitrary file system modification during dependency download.

Dependency names from gleam.toml and manifest.toml are incorporated into filesystem paths without sufficient validation or confinement to the intended dependency directory, allowing attacker-controlled paths (via relative traversal such as ../ or absolute paths) to target filesystem locations outside that directory. When resolving git dependencies (e.g. via gleam deps download), the computed path is used for filesystem operations including directory deletion and creation.

This vulnerability occurs during the dependency resolution and download phase, which is generally expected to be limited to fetching and preparing dependencies within a confined directory. A malicious direct or transitive git dependency can exploit this issue to delete and overwrite arbitrary directories outside the intended dependency directory, including attacker-chosen absolute paths, potentially causing data loss. In some environments, this may be further leveraged to achieve code execution, for example by overwriting git hooks or shell configuration files.

This issue affects Gleam from 1.9.0-rc1 until 1.15.4.

A flaw has been found in D-Link DIR-895L A1_102b07. This impacts the function sendOffer/sendACK of the file udhcpcd/serverpacket.c of the component udhcpcd. This manipulation causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can only be done within the local network. The exploit has been published and may be used.

ai.summary_en: The day's curated vulnerabilities reveal a significant threat landscape dominated by remote code execution and authentication bypass flaws, with Microsoft products accounting for the majority of high-risk findings across desktop operating systems, cloud infrastructure, and web applications. Critical issues include heap-based buffer overflows and use-after-free errors in Windows networking components and SQL Server that facilitate lateral movement and privilege escalation, alongside severe authorization weaknesses in Azure AD B2C and Azure DNS that risk complete identity takeover. Additionally, industrial control systems and IoT devices face exploitation through command injection and cryptographic failures from vendors like Siemens and D-Link, while mobile security concerns highlight path traversal and session fixation risks in popular enterprise apps.
ai.summary_zh: 今日精选漏洞揭示了一个以远程代码执行和身份验证绕过缺陷为主导的重大威胁态势，Microsoft产品占据了桌面操作系统、云基础设施和Web应用中发现的大部分高风险项。关键问题包括Windows网络组件和SQL Server中基于堆的缓冲区溢出及释放后使用错误，这些漏洞有助于横向移动和权限提升；同时Azure AD B2C和Azure DNS中存在严重的授权弱点，可能导致完整的身份接管。此外，工业控制系统和物联网设备面临来自Siemens和D-Link等厂商的命令注入和密码学失效利用风险，而移动安全问题则凸显了流行企业应用中存在的目录遍历与会话固定风险。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Imaging Component allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code without user interaction, significantly increasing the attack surface for endpoint compromise.
items.reason_zh: Windows Imaging Component 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者在无需用户交互的情况下执行任意代码，显著增加了终端被攻陷的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Already listed in CISA KEV, this Windows Update Stack vulnerability enables local privilege escalation via improper link resolution, making it actively exploited and requiring immediate patching.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞已列入 CISA KEV 目录。此 Windows Update Stack 漏洞可通过链接解析不当实现本地权限提升，目前正遭积极利用，需立即修补。

items.reason_en: The heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word facilitates network-based code execution, serving as a high-value target for spear-phishing campaigns targeting enterprise workstations.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可促成基于网络的代码执行，使其成为针对企业工作站的鱼叉式网络钓鱼活动的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free flaw in Windows Message Queuing permits remote code execution over the network, threatening server infrastructure and inter-process communication reliability.
items.reason_zh: Windows Message Queuing 中的释放后使用缺陷允许通过网络执行远程代码，威胁服务器基础设施及进程间通信的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Critical use-after-free flaw in Windows Failover Cluster enables remote code execution over the network, posing a severe threat to enterprise clustering infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows Failover Cluster 中的严重释放后使用缺陷可启用网络远程代码执行，对企业集群基础设施构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word allows remote code execution, making it a prime target for malicious document-based phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，使其成为恶意文档网络钓鱼活动的首要目标。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in Windows Print Spooler Components can lead to local privilege escalation, continuing the risk pattern seen in historical print-related exploits.
items.reason_zh: Windows Print Spooler Components 中的双重释放漏洞可能导致本地权限提升，延续了历史上打印相关漏洞利用的风险模式。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Credential Guard may compromise the secure hardware-backed isolation mechanism, risking exposure of sensitive credentials and Kerberos tickets.
items.reason_zh: Windows Credential Guard 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可能破坏安全的硬件支持隔离机制，导致敏感凭据和 Kerberos 票据面临泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Shell enables remote code execution via crafted files, making it a high-priority target for drive-by attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过构造文件实现远程代码执行，使其成为路过攻击的高优先级目标。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Windows PDF parser allows remote code execution when opening malicious documents, significantly increasing phishing campaign effectiveness.
items.reason_zh: Windows PDF 解析器中的整数溢出漏洞在打开恶意文档时允许远程代码执行，显著提升了网络钓鱼活动的成功率。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in DirectShow permits remote code execution through malicious media streams, exploiting widely used multimedia processing libraries.
items.reason_zh: DirectShow 中的越界读取漏洞可通过恶意媒体流实现远程代码执行，利用了广泛使用的多媒体处理库。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in the Standard XPS driver leads to remote code execution, leveraging another commonly processed document format for initial access.
items.reason_zh: Standard XPS 驱动程序中的整数下溢可导致远程代码执行，攻击者可利用另一种常见处理的文档格式进行初始访问。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the HTTP Print Provider enables remote code execution over networks, capitalizing on historical weaknesses in Windows printing subsystems.
items.reason_zh: HTTP Print Provider 中的堆溢出漏洞可启用网络远程代码执行，利用了 Windows 打印子系统的历史弱点。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Windows Kernel allows unauthenticated remote code execution, directly compromising core operating system stability and security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows 内核中的堆溢出漏洞允许无需身份验证的远程代码执行，直接破坏了操作系统的核心稳定性与安全边界。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Remote Desktop Services enables remote code execution over networks, targeting a critical administrative access vector frequently exploited by threat actors.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Services 中的释放后使用漏洞可启用网络远程代码执行，针对威胁行为体频繁利用的关键管理访问途径。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Event Logging Service allows unauthorized network-based code execution with a CVSS of 9.8. This flaw critically undermines system telemetry and security monitoring capabilities.
items.reason_zh: 事件日志服务中的越界读取漏洞允许未经授权的基于网络的代码执行（CVSS 9.8）。该缺陷严重削弱了系统遥测与安全防护监控能力。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Media Foundation enables unauthorized network RCE (CVSS 8.8). Its broad usage in browsers and media players makes it a high-value target for drive-by exploits.
items.reason_zh: Media Foundation 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可启用未经授权的远程代码执行（CVSS 8.8）。其在浏览器和媒体播放器中的广泛使用使其成为路过漏洞利用的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Microsoft Office Word permits unauthorized network code execution (CVSS 8.8). Malicious document delivery remains one of the most prevalent initial access vectors for threat actors.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的堆溢出漏洞允许未经授权的远程代码执行（CVSS 8.8）。恶意文档投递仍是威胁行为体最常用的初始访问途径之一。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the USB Mass Storage Class Driver allows unauthorized network code execution (CVSS 9.8). This creates a significant risk for physical or network-adjacent persistence attacks.
items.reason_zh: USB 大容量存储类驱动程序中的堆溢出漏洞允许未经授权的远程代码执行（CVSS 9.8）。这为物理接触或邻近网络的持久化攻击带来了重大风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in URL Moniker enables unauthorized network RCE (CVSS 8.8). Attackers can leverage this to execute arbitrary code when users navigate to crafted web content.
items.reason_zh: URL Moniker 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可启用未经授权的远程代码执行（CVSS 8.8）。当用户访问构造的网页内容时，攻击者可借此执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Listed in CISA KEV, this heap-based buffer overflow in Windows ALPC enables local privilege escalation, confirming active exploitation in the wild.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞已列入 CISA KEV。此 Windows ALPC 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可启用本地权限提升，证实了野外存在积极利用情况。

items.reason_en: A critical heap overflow in the Print Spooler allows unauthenticated remote code execution, posing an immediate threat to endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: Print Spooler 中的严重堆溢出漏洞允许无需身份验证的远程代码执行，对终端安全构成即时威胁。

items.reason_en: High-severity stack overflow in Windows Netlogon permits unauthorized network code execution, directly compromising domain controller authentication mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Windows Netlogon 中的高危栈溢出漏洞允许未经授权的远程代码执行，直接破坏了域控制器的身份验证机制。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in the Windows Graphics Component enables remote code execution via malicious display drivers or payloads.
items.reason_zh: Windows Graphics Component 中的双重释放漏洞可通过恶意显示驱动程序或有效载荷实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 remote code execution in Windows DHCP Server allows unauthenticated network attackers to gain full system control, posing a critical threat to enterprise network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中 CVSS 9.8 分的远程代码执行漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络攻击者获取完全的系统控制权，对企业网络基础设施构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: A critical CVSS 9.8 use-after-free flaw in Windows DNS enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, directly compromising core name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中一项严重的 CVSS 9.8 分释放后使用缺陷可启用无需身份验证的网络远程代码执行，直接破坏了核心名称解析服务。

items.reason_en: With a CVSS score of 9.8, this out-of-bounds write in the RPC Runtime allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely, exploiting a fundamental Windows communication protocol.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞 CVSS 评分为 9.8。RPC 运行时中的越界写入漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者远程执行任意代码，利用了 Windows 的基础通信协议。

items.reason_en: This CVSS 8.8 Kerberos authentication bypass via capture-replay allows attackers to hijack credentials and execute code over the network, severely undermining Active Directory security.
items.reason_zh: 此项 CVSS 8.8 分的 Kerberos 捕获重放认证绕过漏洞使攻击者能够劫持凭据并在网络上执行代码，严重破坏了 Active Directory 的安全性。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Key Distribution Center (CVSS 8.8) enables authenticated attackers to execute code over the network, threatening centralized identity management.
items.reason_zh: Windows 密钥分发中心 (KDC) 中的释放后使用漏洞 (CVSS 8.8) 允许已认证的攻击者通过网络执行代码，威胁集中式身份管理。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Remote Desktop (CVSS 8.8) allows unauthenticated remote code execution, making it a prime target for ransomware and lateral movement attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Remote Desktop 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞 (CVSS 8.8) 允许无需身份验证的远程代码执行，使其成为勒索软件和横向移动攻击的首要目标。

items.reason_en: This CVSS 8.8 heap overflow in Windows Hyper-V allows local privilege escalation, potentially enabling a compromised guest VM to break isolation and take control of the host system.
items.reason_zh: 该 CVSS 8.8 分的 Windows Hyper-V 堆溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，可能使受损的客户机虚拟机突破隔离机制并接管主机系统。

items.reason_en: A CVSS 8.0 heap overflow in the Windows NTFS file system driver allows local privilege escalation, which can be exploited by malware to gain SYSTEM-level access on affected machines.
items.reason_zh: Windows NTFS 文件系统驱动程序中的 CVSS 8.0 堆溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，恶意软件可利用该漏洞在受影响设备上获取 SYSTEM 级访问权限。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows Win32K (CVSS 8.0) facilitates local privilege escalation over the network, impacting core graphical subsystem stability and security.
items.reason_zh: Windows Win32K（CVSS 8.0）中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现通过网络触发的本地权限提升，影响核心图形子系统的稳定性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Double free in Windows Credential Guard (CVSS 8.2) allows local privilege escalation, potentially exposing hardware-backed secrets and undermining secure credential storage mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Windows Credential Guard（CVSS 8.2）中的双重释放漏洞可导致本地权限提升，可能暴露硬件支持的密钥并破坏安全的凭据存储机制。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Windows SMB Client (CVSS 7.8) enables local privilege escalation when processing malicious network shares, complicating secure file sharing operations.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB 客户端（CVSS 7.8）中的堆溢出漏洞在处理恶意网络共享时可导致本地权限提升，增加了安全文件共享操作的复杂性。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Microsoft Office Publisher (CVSS 8.8) allows unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted documents, representing a significant phishing and malware delivery risk.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Publisher（CVSS 8.8）中的整数溢出漏洞允许通过构造的文档实现未认证的远程代码执行，构成严重的钓鱼攻击和恶意软件投递风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word (CVSS 8.8) enables unauthenticated remote code execution from malicious files, requiring immediate patching to prevent document-based exploits.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word（CVSS 8.8）中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过恶意文件实现未认证的远程代码执行，需立即修补以防止基于文档的攻击利用。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Microsoft Office PowerPoint (CVSS 8.8) allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, posing a direct threat to presentation-based attack vectors.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office PowerPoint（CVSS 8.8）中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络实现未认证的远程代码执行，对基于演示文稿的攻击向量构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Paint (CVSS 8.8) permits unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, expanding the attack surface for image-processing exploits.
items.reason_zh: Windows 画图工具（CVSS 8.8）中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络实现未认证的远程代码执行，扩大了图像处理类漏洞的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Critical remote code execution flaw in Remote Desktop Services allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, posing a severe risk to enterprise terminal server environments.
items.reason_zh: 远程桌面服务（Remote Desktop Services）中存在关键远程代码执行漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，对企业终端服务器环境构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the compressed folder service enables unauthenticated network-based code execution, which can be leveraged through malicious archive files delivered via phishing or shared drives.
items.reason_zh: 压缩文件夹服务中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现未认证的基于网络的代码执行，攻击者可借助通过钓鱼攻击或共享驱动器分发的恶意归档文件加以利用。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in the legacy Telnet client presents a significant attack surface, especially in environments where outdated protocols remain enabled for device management.
items.reason_zh: 传统 Telnet 客户端中的未认证远程代码执行漏洞构成了显著的攻击面，尤其在仍启用过时协议进行设备管理的环境中风险更高。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Windows Media Foundation allows unauthenticated network-based code execution when processing crafted media files, impacting users who open malicious multimedia content.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中的整数溢出漏洞在处理构造的媒体文件时可实现未认证的基于网络的代码执行，影响打开恶意多媒体内容的用户。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in the core UxTheme library facilitates unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, bypassing standard UI security boundaries and affecting system stability.
items.reason_zh: 核心 UxTheme 库中的整数下溢漏洞可促成通过网络实现的未认证远程代码执行，绕过标准 UI 安全边界并影响系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Critical heap overflow in the NTFS driver permits unauthenticated network-based code execution, threatening file server integrity and enabling potential lateral movement within Active Directory domains.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 驱动程序中的关键堆溢出漏洞允许未认证的基于网络的代码执行，威胁文件服务器完整性，并可能在 Active Directory 域内实现潜在的横向移动。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Active Directory Domain Services allows unauthenticated network-based code execution, directly compromising identity infrastructure and enabling full domain takeover.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory 域服务（Active Directory Domain Services）中的释放后使用漏洞允许未认证的基于网络的代码执行，直接破坏身份基础设施并可能导致整个域被接管。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in NTFS enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, making it highly exploitable against file shares and storage systems.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现通过网络进行的未认证远程代码执行，使其极易针对文件共享和存储系统进行利用。

items.reason_en: The Print Spooler UAF vulnerability enables remote privilege escalation, leveraging a historically targeted Windows subsystem frequently abused for lateral movement in enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: Print Spooler（打印后台处理程序）的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞可实现远程权限提升，该子系统历来是攻击目标，在企业环境中常被滥用于横向移动。

items.reason_en: Remote Desktop Services contains a use-after-free flaw allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, posing a direct threat to critical remote access infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 远程桌面服务（Remote Desktop Services）存在释放后使用漏洞，允许未认证的远程代码执行，对关键远程访问基础设施构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: A race condition in the Windows SMB stack can lead to remote privilege escalation, exploiting a core networking protocol widely targeted by ransomware and file-sharing attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB 协议栈中的竞争条件漏洞可导致远程权限提升，该核心网络协议广泛成为勒索软件和文件共享攻击的目标。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the NTFS driver allows local code execution, potentially enabling attackers to compromise core filesystem operations and escalate to system-level privileges.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 驱动程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许本地代码执行，可能使攻击者破坏核心文件系统操作并提升至系统级权限。

items.reason_en: Severe use-after-free flaw in the Windows VMSwitch driver allows local privilege escalation with potential network-triggered exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Windows VMSwitch 驱动程序中的严重释放后使用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，且存在通过网络触发利用的潜在风险。

items.reason_en: Uninitialized resource handling in Windows Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) enables unauthorized remote code execution without authentication.
items.reason_zh: Windows 远程桌面协议（RDP）中的未初始化资源处理漏洞可在无需认证的情况下实现未授权的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server service permits remote attackers to achieve code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP 服务器服务中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者通过网络实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: Inclusion of functionality from untrusted control spheres in Visual Studio Code allows attackers to bypass built-in security restrictions remotely.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中集成来自不受信任控制域的函数功能，可使攻击者远程绕过内置安全限制。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word enables local code execution when processing specially crafted documents.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞在处理特制文档时可导致本地代码执行。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free flaw in the Windows Kernel enables local privilege escalation, directly compromising host operating system integrity and bypassing standard user-mode protections.
items.reason_zh: Windows 内核中的释放后使用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，直接破坏主机操作系统完整性并绕过标准的用户模式保护机制。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in .NET allows arbitrary local code execution, posing a severe threat to enterprise workstations and development environments.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中对不受信任数据进行反序列化可导致任意本地代码执行，对企业工作站和开发环境构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in Windows OLE can be exploited remotely to execute code, bypassing standard desktop application sandboxing mechanisms and enabling initial footholds.
items.reason_zh: Windows OLE 中的类型混淆漏洞可被远程利用以执行代码，绕过标准桌面应用程序的沙箱机制并建立初始立足点。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Message Queuing enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, severely impacting Windows messaging infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows 消息队列（Message Queuing）中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络实现未认证的远程代码执行，严重影响 Windows 消息传递基础设施。

items.reason_en: Critical heap overflow in the iSCSI Target Service allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code, potentially compromising enterprise storage networks without authentication.
items.reason_zh: iSCSI Target Service 中存在关键堆溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者执行任意代码，可能在未认证的情况下危及企业存储网络。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Remote Desktop Services permits network-based privilege escalation, directly endangering widely deployed remote access solutions.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Services 中的释放后使用漏洞允许基于网络的提权，直接威胁广泛部署的远程访问解决方案。

items.reason_en: Windows Runtime use-after-free flaw facilitates local privilege escalation across numerous modern Windows applications and background services.
items.reason_zh: Windows Runtime 中的释放后使用缺陷可促成本地提权，影响众多现代 Windows 应用程序及后台服务。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Windows NAT enables network spoofing from adjacent segments, significantly aiding lateral movement in corporate environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows NAT 中的源验证错误允许来自相邻网段的网络欺骗，显著助长企业环境中的横向移动。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows Runtime allows unauthorized network-based privilege escalation, affecting core APIs used across multiple Windows versions.
items.reason_zh: Windows Runtime 中的竞态条件允许未经授权的基于网络的提权，影响跨多个 Windows 版本使用的核心 API。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel permits local code execution via malicious documents, maintaining high user exposure risk.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过恶意文档实现本地代码执行，保持较高的用户暴露风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows GDI+ allows remote code execution over a network with a critical CVSS of 9.6, making it a high-priority target for attackers.
items.reason_zh: Windows GDI+ 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，CVSS 评分高达关键的 9.6，使其成为攻击者的优先目标。

items.reason_en: This link resolution flaw in the Windows User Profile Service carries the highest EPSS score (0.033) in the batch, indicating a strong likelihood of exploitation for local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Windows User Profile Service 中的此链接解析缺陷在本批次中拥有最高的 EPSS 评分（0.033），表明其被利用以实现本地提权的可能性极高。

items.reason_en: An integer underflow in HTTP.sys presents a significant local privilege escalation risk on Windows servers hosting web applications.
items.reason_zh: HTTP.sys 中的整数下溢漏洞对托管 Web 应用的 Windows 服务器构成显著的本地提权风险。

items.reason_en: A race condition in core Windows operating system components provides a reliable vector for unauthorized local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: 核心 Windows 操作系统组件中的竞态条件为未经授权的本地提权提供了可靠的攻击向量。

items.reason_en: A critical use-after-free flaw in Win32K allows unauthorized local privilege escalation, directly compromising the Windows kernel and endpoint security posture.
items.reason_zh: Win32K 中的关键释放后使用缺陷允许未经授权的本地提权，直接破坏 Windows 内核及终端安全态势。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client enables remote code execution over a network, leveraging the widespread deployment of RDP for lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，借助 RDP 的广泛部署实现横向移动。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Excel permits local code execution via malicious documents, presenting a high-risk vector for targeted phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Excel 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过恶意文档实现本地代码执行，为定向钓鱼活动提供高风险攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Windows Admin Center allows local code execution, undermining enterprise device management workflows and administrative boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows Admin Center 中的授权不当漏洞允许本地代码执行，削弱企业设备管理工作流及管理边界。

items.reason_en: Critical Print Spooler race condition enables network-based remote code execution on Windows systems.
items.reason_zh: Print Spooler 中的关键竞态条件可在 Windows 系统上实现基于网络的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Kernel mode driver use-after-free flaw allows unprivileged local attackers to escalate privileges to SYSTEM level.
items.reason_zh: 内核模式驱动程序的释放后使用缺陷允许无特权的本地攻击者将权限提升至 SYSTEM 级别。

items.reason_en: Win32K subsystem use-after-free vulnerability provides a reliable path for local privilege escalation attacks.
items.reason_zh: Win32K 子系统的释放后使用漏洞为本地提权攻击提供了可靠路径。

items.reason_en: TCP/IP stack race condition permits adjacent network attackers to achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: TCP/IP 协议栈的竞态条件允许相邻网络攻击者实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Critical race condition in the Win32K graphics subsystem enables local privilege escalation, frequently targeted via malicious documents or GUI interactions.
items.reason_zh: Win32K 图形子系统的关键竞态条件可启用本地提权，常通过恶意文档或 GUI 交互进行针对性利用。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows kernel allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges locally by corrupting memory structures.
items.reason_zh: Windows 内核中的释放后使用漏洞允许已具备权限的攻击者通过破坏内存结构在本地提升权限。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the Windows kernel creates a local privilege escalation risk when handling malformed system calls or drivers.
items.reason_zh: Windows 内核中的不受信任指针解引用在处理畸形系统调用或驱动程序时会产生本地提权风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Media Foundation permits local code execution through crafted multimedia files processed by the OS.
items.reason_zh: Media Foundation 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过操作系统处理的构造多媒体文件实现本地代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Win32K is a historically high-exploit-rate component for local privilege escalation, posing significant risk to endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: Win32K 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞历来具有较高的利用频率，常被用于本地提权，对终端安全构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Remote Desktop Client network RCE allows unauthorized code execution without user interaction, directly compromising remote management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 的网络远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞允许无需用户交互即可执行未授权代码，直接危及远程管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Adobe Reader enables privilege escalation without user interaction, breaking the application sandbox and granting elevated system access.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Reader 中的授权不正确漏洞允许无需用户交互即可提权，破坏应用沙箱并授予更高的系统访问权限。

items.reason_en: Illustrator's incorrect authorization flaw allows attackers to bypass security controls and achieve arbitrary code execution, posing a direct threat to creative professionals.
items.reason_zh: Illustrator 的授权不正确缺陷允许攻击者绕过安全控制并实现任意代码执行，对创意专业人士构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Bilibili Desktop disables TLS verification globally and executes unsigned JavaScript, enabling network attackers to perform man-in-the-middle attacks and inject malicious scripts.
items.reason_zh: Bilibili Desktop 全局禁用 TLS 验证并执行未签名 JavaScript，使网络攻击者能够实施中间人攻击并注入恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: PassMark tools contain a local privilege escalation vulnerability in DirectIo64.sys that allows unprivileged users to modify hardware configurations via unchecked IOCTLs.
items.reason_zh: PassMark 工具集中的 DirectIo64.sys 存在本地提权漏洞，允许无特权用户通过未经检查的 IOCTL 修改硬件配置。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Adobe Animate enables arbitrary code execution within the current user context.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Animate 中的代码注入漏洞允许在当前用户上下文中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: BIOS input validation flaw allows privileged local users to trigger arbitrary code execution on system firmware.
items.reason_zh: BIOS 输入验证缺陷允许具备特权的本地用户在系统固件上触发任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption in libxslt tree fragment cleanup can lead to information disclosure or application crashes.
items.reason_zh: libxslt 树片段清理过程中的内存损坏可能导致信息泄露或应用程序崩溃。

items.reason_en: Allows remote authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands on Windows hosts via crafted certificate subjects, posing a direct threat to enterprise VPN deployments.
items.reason_zh: 允许远程经过身份验证的攻击者通过构造的证书主题在 Windows 主机上执行任意命令，对企业 VPN 部署构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Enables local privilege escalation to root through symlink attacks and race conditions in the PAM namespace module, compromising system integrity.
items.reason_zh: 通过在 PAM 命名空间模块中利用符号链接攻击和竞态条件实现本地提权至 root，破坏系统完整性。

items.reason_en: Allows unauthenticated nearby users to control hosts with active sessions, posing a significant risk to endpoint management security.
items.reason_zh: 允许未经身份验证的近场用户控制具有活动会话的主机，对终端管理安全构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Clipboard sanitization bypass allows malicious scripts to execute in the desktop renderer, compromising user workstations.
items.reason_zh: 剪贴板内容净化绕过允许恶意脚本在桌面渲染器中执行，危及用户工作站安全。

items.reason_en: Unencrypted local RPC channel allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on developer machines running remote development hosts.
items.reason_zh: 未加密的本地 RPC 通道允许攻击者在运行远程开发主机的开发者机器上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Bypassing project trust prompts allows malicious containers to execute commands at the host level, compromising developer workstations.
items.reason_zh: 绕过项目信任提示允许恶意容器在主机级别执行命令，危及开发者工作站。

items.reason_en: Low-privilege backend manipulation triggers arbitrary command execution on client machines via GUI trust bypass.
items.reason_zh: 低权限后端操纵通过绕过 GUI 信任机制触发客户端机器上的任意命令执行。

items.reason_en: Local attackers can spoof D-Bus mount parameters to escalate privileges, bypassing desktop environment authorization controls.
items.reason_zh: 本地攻击者可伪造 D-Bus 挂载参数以提权，绕过桌面环境授权控制。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Dassault Systèmes 3DPassport enables attackers to compromise user accounts within the engineering software ecosystem.
items.reason_zh: Dassault Systèmes 3DPassport 中的授权不当使攻击者能够入侵工程软件生态系统内的用户账户。

items.reason_en: DLL hijacking in the Siemens setup component allows arbitrary code execution during legitimate application installation, compromising host integrity.
items.reason_zh: Siemens 安装组件中的 DLL 劫持允许在合法应用程序安装期间执行任意代码，破坏主机完整性。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Microsoft Authenticator allows local privilege escalation, undermining the integrity of mobile-based multi-factor authentication.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Authenticator 中的身份验证绕过允许本地提权，削弱基于移动设备的多因素认证完整性。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Microsoft 365 Copilot for iOS could allow unauthorized users to elevate privileges within the mobile productivity suite, risking corporate data on personal devices.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft 365 Copilot for iOS 中的访问控制不当可能允许未经授权的用户提升特权，危及个人设备上的企业数据。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in Microsoft Edge for Android carries a CVSS of 9.0, enabling remote code execution via maliciously crafted web content specifically targeting mobile browsers.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge for Android 中的类型混淆漏洞 CVSS 评分为 9.0，可通过专门针对移动浏览器的恶意构造网页内容实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Edge for Android allows remote attackers to execute code over the network, significantly weakening mobile browsing sandbox protections.
items.reason_zh: Edge for Android 中的路径遍历漏洞允许远程攻击者通过网络执行代码，严重削弱移动浏览器沙箱防护。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in the Android version of Microsoft Teams facilitates mobile-specific spoofing and session hijacking attacks targeting end-users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Teams Android 版中的跨站脚本漏洞助长了针对最终用户的移动端特定欺骗与会话劫持攻击。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server enables remote code execution, impacting cross-platform gaming and mobile ecosystem security.
items.reason_zh: Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现远程代码执行，影响跨平台游戏及移动生态系统安全。

items.reason_en: External control of file name or path in Microsoft Edge for Android leads to local information disclosure, directly impacting mobile browsing security and user data privacy.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge for Android 中的文件名或路径外部控制漏洞导致本地信息泄露，直接影响移动浏览安全和用户数据隐私。

items.reason_en: UI layer restriction flaw in the Bing iOS app enables network-based spoofing and potential credential harvesting on mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: Bing iOS 应用中的 UI 层限制缺陷支持基于网络的欺骗及移动设备上的凭证窃取。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Teams for Android allows unauthorized file system access, exposing sensitive corporate data on mobile endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Teams for Android 中的路径遍历漏洞允许未经授权的文件系统访问，暴露移动终端上的敏感企业数据。

items.reason_en: Android's PermissionsManager lacks critical checks, allowing local attackers to monitor sensitive device state data and disclose information without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Android 的 PermissionsManager 缺乏关键检查机制，允许本地攻击者在无需用户交互的情况下监控敏感设备状态数据并泄露信息。

items.reason_en: MicroXR Blobstore in Android suffers from missing permission checks, enabling local applications to access other apps' files and escalate privileges silently.
items.reason_zh: Android 中的 MicroXR Blobstore 存在权限检查缺失问题，使本地应用能够访问其他应用文件并静默提权。

items.reason_en: Session fixation vulnerability in Photoshop Mobile allows privilege escalation and unauthorized access to sensitive resources.
items.reason_zh: Photoshop Mobile 中的会话固定漏洞允许提权及未经授权访问敏感资源。

items.reason_en: Missing rate limiting on authentication attempts enables brute-force bypass and unauthorized application access.
items.reason_zh: 身份验证尝试缺少速率限制可导致暴力破解绕过及未经授权的应用程序访问。

items.reason_en: Permits authenticated BLE peers to overflow a static buffer in the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Service, potentially leading to code execution on paired smartphones and medical wearables.
items.reason_zh: 允许经过身份验证的 BLE 对等设备溢出连续血糖监测服务中的静态缓冲区，可能在配对的智能手机和医疗可穿戴设备上导致代码执行。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded TLS rejection bypass in Eclipse Ditto exposes IoT device communications to interception and tampering across industrial networks.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse Ditto 中的硬编码 TLS 拒绝绕过漏洞使工业网络中的物联网设备通信面临被拦截和篡改的风险。

items.reason_en: TP-Link RE210 routers suffer from a stack-based buffer overflow in the web interface, allowing authenticated local attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted configuration uploads.
items.reason_zh: TP-Link RE210 路由器 Web 界面存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许经过身份验证的本地攻击者通过构造的配置上传执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Silicon Labs RS9116W wireless modules experience a denial of service when processing unencrypted pause requests, disrupting IoT connectivity in embedded systems.
items.reason_zh: Silicon Labs RS9116W 无线模块在处理未加密的暂停请求时会出现拒绝服务漏洞，中断嵌入式系统中的物联网连接。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in D-Link DHCP client allows remote code execution with publicly disclosed exploits.
items.reason_zh: D-Link DHCP 客户端中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可利用公开披露的漏洞利用程序实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: OS command injection via manipulated alarm URL parameter in Tenda routers enables remote exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Tenda 路由器中通过操纵告警 URL 参数实现的操作系统命令注入漏洞可被远程利用。

items.reason_en: Shell command injection in HTTP RPC log writer via unsanitized usernames is actively exploited in the wild.
items.reason_zh: HTTP RPC日志写入器中因未过滤用户名导致Shell命令注入漏洞，目前已在野外被积极利用。

items.reason_en: Presents a critical remote buffer overflow in Tenda routers that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve full device compromise and network pivoting.
items.reason_zh: Tenda路由器中存在关键远程缓冲区溢出漏洞，可能导致未经身份验证的攻击者完全控制设备并进行网络横向移动。

items.reason_en: Bypasses secure boot verification during Direct XIP updates, allowing malicious firmware to run on Nordic Semiconductor-based IoT devices without detection.
items.reason_zh: 在Direct XIP更新过程中绕过安全启动验证，致使恶意固件可在基于Nordic Semiconductor的IoT设备上静默运行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in flight controller software could destabilize drone autopilot systems, risking physical crashes.
items.reason_zh: 飞控软件中的释放后使用漏洞可能导致无人机自动驾驶系统失稳，进而引发坠机风险。

items.reason_en: Race condition during I2C adapter teardown can cause use-after-free errors, destabilizing embedded hardware drivers.
items.reason_zh: I2C适配器卸载过程中的竞争条件可能引发释放后使用漏洞，导致嵌入式硬件驱动程序失稳。

items.reason_en: Concurrent registration operations may corrupt device references, leading to driver crashes in IoT subsystems.
items.reason_zh: 并发注册操作可能破坏设备引用，导致IoT子系统驱动程序崩溃。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the D-Link DHCP client daemon permits remote code execution or denial-of-service from adjacent network attackers.
items.reason_zh: D-Link DHCP客户端守护进程中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可使相邻网络攻击者实现远程代码执行或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Insufficient parameter sanitization in the Siemens SCALANCE edge device enables unprivileged local attackers to execute root-level commands.
items.reason_zh: Siemens SCALANCE边缘设备中参数校验不足，使得无权限本地攻击者可执行root级别命令。

items.reason_en: With a perfect CVSS score of 10.0, this authorization bypass in Azure AD B2C allows complete identity takeover and privilege escalation, critically undermining cloud identity management.
items.reason_zh: 该Azure AD B2C授权绕过漏洞CVSS评分高达10.0，可导致完整的身份接管与权限提升，严重破坏云身份管理体系。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure AI Language exposes core cloud functions to unauthorized access, risking sensitive data exposure and service abuse at scale.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Language缺失身份验证机制，导致核心云功能暴露于未授权访问之下，存在敏感数据泄露及服务大规模滥用的风险。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in MSAL for Node.js compromises secure token validation, allowing attackers to spoof identities in cloud-native applications.
items.reason_zh: MSAL for Node.js中通过捕获重放可绕过身份验证，破坏安全令牌校验机制，致使攻击者能在云原生应用中伪造身份。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Spring Cloud Azure enables unauthorized privilege elevation, directly threatening hybrid cloud deployments and microservice architectures.
items.reason_zh: Spring Cloud Azure身份验证机制不当，可导致未授权权限提升，直接威胁混合云部署与微服务架构安全。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dynamics 365 allows remote code execution, exposing critical cloud-based ERP and CRM workloads to compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365中对不可信数据进行反序列化可导致远程代码执行，使关键云端ERP与CRM工作负载面临被攻陷风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint permits unauthorized network-based code execution, undermining access controls in enterprise collaboration environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint缺失授权检查，允许未授权的网络端代码执行，削弱了企业协作环境中的访问控制机制。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Hyper-V enables local code execution, risking hypervisor isolation and potential guest-to-host escape scenarios.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V中不可信指针解引用可导致本地代码执行，危及Hypervisor隔离性，并存在Guest至Host逃逸风险。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure HDInsights allows unauthorized feature bypass and could facilitate internal network pivoting from compromised instances.
items.reason_zh: Azure HDInsights存在服务器端请求伪造漏洞，可导致未授权功能绕过，并可能被用于从已攻陷实例进行内网横向移动。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure DNS (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated attackers to elevate privileges, directly risking the integrity of critical cloud DNS resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Azure DNS（CVSS 10.0）缺失授权机制，允许未认证攻击者提权，直接危及关键云DNS解析基础设施的完整性。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Azure App Service enables remote privilege escalation, threatening the isolation and security of containerized and serverless application workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure App Service访问控制不当可导致远程权限提升，威胁容器化及Serverless应用工作负载的隔离性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Microsoft Entra ID allows unauthorized privilege elevation, directly compromising modern identity and access management controls across hybrid clouds.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID身份验证绕过漏洞可导致未授权提权，直接破坏跨混合云环境的现代身份与访问管理控制体系。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Exchange Online permits remote tampering, jeopardizing enterprise email security, compliance mandates, and secure communications.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Online身份验证机制不当可导致远程篡改行为，危及企业邮件安全、合规要求及安全通信。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication mechanism in Microsoft Office SharePoint has been actively exploited in the wild, allowing unauthorized security feature bypasses.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint身份验证机制薄弱，目前已在野外被积极利用，可导致未授权的安全特性绕过。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse grants authenticated attackers the ability to execute arbitrary code over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，经身份验证的攻击者可借此通过网络执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Command injection vulnerability in Windows Admin Center allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary commands remotely.
items.reason_zh: Windows Admin Center存在命令注入漏洞，允许已认证用户远程执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal flaw in Windows Admin Center enables authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code by manipulating file paths.
items.reason_zh: Windows Admin Center存在相对路径遍历漏洞，已认证攻击者可通过操纵文件路径执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Critical authorization bypass in Azure Arc enables remote privilege escalation, severely impacting hybrid cloud management planes and infrastructure governance.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc存在关键授权绕过漏洞，可导致远程提权，严重冲击混合云管理面及基础设施治理体系。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Azure Logic Apps allows attackers to escalate privileges and manipulate cloud workflow executions across tenant boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Azure Logic Apps存在路径遍历漏洞，攻击者可借此提权并跨租户边界操纵云工作流执行。

items.reason_en: Incorrect reference resolution in Azure Arc leads to remote privilege escalation, threatening the stability and security of deployed cloud resources.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc引用解析错误可导致远程提权，威胁已部署云资源的稳定性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Improper permission assignment in Azure SQL Database enables local privilege escalation, risking multi-tenant isolation and data confidentiality in cloud environments.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database权限分配不当可导致本地提权，危及云环境中的多租户隔离性与数据机密性。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Entra Connect Sync compromises identity synchronization services, potentially allowing attackers to manipulate cloud directory structures.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra Connect Sync存在SQL注入漏洞，将破坏身份同步服务，攻击者可能借此操纵云目录结构。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in Azure Connected Machine Agent enables adjacent network privilege escalation, weakening cloud-to-edge identity and device trust models.
items.reason_zh: Azure Connected Machine Agent证书验证机制不当可导致相邻网络提权，削弱云边协同身份与设备信任模型。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure CycleCloud allows network privilege escalation, exposing container orchestration management interfaces to unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中缺失授权机制可导致网络权限提升，使容器编排管理接口暴露于未授权访问之下。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Azure Active Directory causes network denial of service, threatening core identity federation and authentication services.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中对不信任数据进行反序列化会导致网络拒绝服务，威胁核心身份联合与认证服务。

items.reason_en: Incorrect network binding in OpenShift AI dashboard allows cluster-local attackers to bypass authentication and impersonate users.
items.reason_zh: OpenShift AI 仪表板的错误网络绑定配置允许集群本地攻击者绕过认证并冒充用户。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure CycleCloud enables unauthorized network privilege escalation on cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中缺失认证机制可致使云工作负载遭受未授权的网络权限提升。

items.reason_en: Red Hat DSPO operator misconfiguration permits dangerous MySQL DSN parameter injection, compromising database connectivity.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat DSPO Operator 配置不当允许危险的 MySQL DSN 参数注入，破坏数据库连接性。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure Kubernetes Service allows unauthorized users to escalate privileges and fully control container orchestration workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 中缺失认证机制允许未授权用户提升权限并完全控制容器编排工作负载。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure OpenAI enables attackers to pivot internally, exfiltrate sensitive data, or escalate privileges within cloud tenants.
items.reason_zh: Azure OpenAI 中的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞可使攻击者进行内部横向移动、外泄敏感数据或在云租户内提升权限。

items.reason_en: SSRF vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service compromises identity synchronization processes, risking widespread directory and credential theft.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service 中的 SSRF 漏洞会破坏身份同步流程，导致大规模目录和凭据窃取风险。

items.reason_en: Open redirect flaw in M365 Copilot facilitates phishing and authentication bypass attacks targeting enterprise users and administrators.
items.reason_zh: M365 Copilot 中的开放重定向漏洞助长了针对企业用户和管理员的钓鱼及认证绕过攻击。

items.reason_en: Critical deserialization flaw in Microsoft Entra ID allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code, potentially compromising global identity and access management.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中的严重反序列化漏洞允许远程攻击者执行任意代码，可能危及全局身份与访问管理系统。

items.reason_en: SSRF in Azure Active Directory enables authenticated attackers to pivot internally and elevate privileges, threatening cloud tenant security.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中的 SSRF 漏洞可使已认证攻击者进行内部横向移动并提升权限，威胁云租户安全。

items.reason_en: Untrusted data deserialization in HPC Pack permits remote code execution over the network, jeopardizing high-performance computing clusters.
items.reason_zh: HPC Pack 中的不信任数据反序列化漏洞允许通过网络实现远程代码执行，危及高性能计算集群安全。

items.reason_en: N-central is actively exploited in the wild due to a pre-authentication remote code execution flaw, granting attackers full control over managed IT environments.
items.reason_zh: 由于存在预认证远程代码执行漏洞，N-central 已在野外被积极利用，攻击者可借此完全控制受管 IT 环境。

items.reason_en: Gitea's diffpatch API allows unauthenticated remote code execution via malicious Git hooks, severely compromising source code management platforms.
items.reason_zh: Gitea 的 diffpatch API 允许通过恶意 Git 钩子实现未认证的远程代码执行，严重危及源代码管理平台安全。

items.reason_en: Red Hat's Konnectivity proxy-server misconfiguration leaves agent authentication unvalidated, enabling remote attackers to intercept and manipulate Kubernetes cluster traffic.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Konnectivity proxy-server 配置不当导致代理认证未被验证，使远程攻击者能够拦截并篡改 Kubernetes 集群流量。

items.reason_en: Snowflake drivers fail to verify cloud workload-identity tokens against configured endpoints, allowing attackers to forge authentication requests and bypass access controls.
items.reason_zh: Snowflake 驱动程序未针对配置的端点验证云工作负载身份令牌，允许攻击者伪造认证请求并绕过访问控制。

items.reason_en: Hawtio operator misuse of OpenShift Service CA key allows minting arbitrary client certificates, compromising cluster trust.
items.reason_zh: Hawtio Operator 滥用 OpenShift Service CA 密钥可签发任意客户端证书，破坏集群信任关系。

items.reason_en: Symlink validation flaw in KubeVirt allows namespace-restricted users to escape VM consoles and access host filesystems.
items.reason_zh: KubeVirt 中的符号链接验证漏洞允许命名空间受限用户逃逸 VM 控制台并访问主机文件系统。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated deserialization vulnerability in Ivanti Neurons enables remote code execution on ITSM servers.
items.reason_zh: Ivanti Neurons 中的未认证反序列化漏洞可在 ITSM 服务器上触发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Cluster-scoped OAuthClient misconfiguration with auto-grant approval exposes tenant routes to unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: 具有自动授权批准的集群作用域 OAuthClient 配置不当，导致租户路由暴露于未授权访问之下。

items.reason_en: Allows users with basic namespace edit privileges to inject malicious Helm repositories into Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management, risking cluster-wide compromise.
items.reason_zh: 允许具备基础命名空间编辑权限的用户向 Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management 注入恶意 Helm 仓库，引发全集群安全风险。

items.reason_en: Fails to enforce cross-namespace restrictions in Kubernetes ingress middleware, enabling tenant isolation bypasses and unauthorized service configuration.
items.reason_zh: Kubernetes Ingress 中间件未能强制执行跨命名空间限制，导致租户隔离被绕过及未授权的服务配置。

items.reason_en: Critical Kubernetes RBAC bypass allows namespace-local users to escalate to cluster-admin privileges instantly.
items.reason_zh: 严重的 Kubernetes RBAC 绕过漏洞允许命名空间本地用户立即提升至 cluster-admin 权限。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated job injection breaks tenant isolation and enables arbitrary workload execution across managed clusters.
items.reason_zh: 未经验证的作业注入破坏了租户隔离，并允许在受管集群间执行任意工作负载。

items.reason_en: Improper CSR validation allows spoofed service accounts to gain cluster access, compromising Kubernetes security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: CSR 验证不当允许伪造的服务账号获取集群访问权限，破坏 Kubernetes 安全边界。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated proxy requests bypass authorization checks, exposing internal cluster services to external attackers.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的代理请求绕过了授权检查，将内部集群服务暴露给外部攻击者。

items.reason_en: Tenant-controlled URLs fetched server-side bypass egress restrictions, enabling malicious package injection and supply chain attacks.
items.reason_zh: 服务端获取的租户控制 URL 绕过了出站限制，导致恶意包注入和供应链攻击。

items.reason_en: Identity management flaw in Red Hat Keycloak allows unauthenticated attackers to force password resets for any user, severely compromising authentication workflows.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Keycloak 的身份管理漏洞允许未认证攻击者强制重置任意用户的密码，严重破坏认证工作流。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the NFSv4.0 LOCK replay cache within NFSD enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on distributed file servers.
items.reason_zh: NFSD 中 NFSv4.0 LOCK 重放缓存的堆溢出漏洞使远程攻击者能够在分布式文件服务器上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Neglected ACL assignment during NFSv4 file creation results in default permissions being applied, inadvertently exposing sensitive files to unauthorized users.
items.reason_zh: NFSv4 文件创建过程中遗漏 ACL 分配将应用默认权限，无意中使敏感文件暴露给未授权用户。

items.reason_en: Unbounded GraphQL query depth in Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security allows authenticated users to exhaust server resources and trigger service degradation.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security 中无限制的 GraphQL 查询深度允许经过身份验证的用户耗尽服务器资源并导致服务降级。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in Windows iSCSI allows unauthorized attackers to bypass security features over the network, threatening storage area network integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的弱身份验证允许未授权攻击者通过网络绕过安全功能，威胁存储区域网络完整性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Windows Secure Socket Tunneling Protocol (SSTP) enables remote code execution, directly impacting VPN connectivity and remote access security.
