items.reason_en: Incorrect ACI bind-rule evaluation in 389 Directory Server allows anonymous LDAP clients to bypass access controls, exposing sensitive directory structures and credentials.
items.reason_zh: 389 Directory Server 中不正确的 ACI 绑定规则评估允许匿名 LDAP 客户端绕过访问控制，暴露敏感目录结构和凭据。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in 389 Directory Server's SASL I/O layer enables potential memory corruption during authenticated connections, risking middleware exploitation.
items.reason_zh: 389 Directory Server 的 SASL I/O 层中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可在身份验证连接期间导致潜在的内存损坏，存在中间件被利用的风险。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dynamics NAV allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics NAV 中不受信任数据的反序列化允许未认证的攻击者通过网络执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in the Extensible Storage Engine (ESENT) enables local privilege escalation by manipulating database storage operations.
items.reason_zh: Extensible Storage Engine (ESENT) 中的访问控制不当可通过操纵数据库存储操作实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Azure SQL Database permits remote privilege escalation, risking complete data exfiltration and administrative control over cloud databases.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许远程权限提升，可能导致数据完全泄露及对云数据库的管理员控制权。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra enables remote code execution, critical for securing distributed NoSQL database architectures.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra 中的参数注入漏洞可导致远程代码执行，对于保护分布式 NoSQL 数据库架构至关重要。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in on-premises SQL Server allows network-based privilege escalation, endangering traditional relational database deployments and middleware integrations.
items.reason_zh: on-premises SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，危及传统关系型数据库部署和中间件集成。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the .NET runtime allows local code execution, directly impacting the stability and security of millions of dependent applications.
items.reason_zh: .NET 运行时中的越界写入漏洞可导致本地代码执行，直接影响数百万依赖应用的稳定性和安全性。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in .NET Framework permits local privilege escalation, remaining a significant risk for legacy enterprise middleware deployments.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中的路径遍历漏洞可导致本地权限提升，仍是遗留企业中间件部署的重大风险。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in .NET allows network security feature bypass, undermining runtime integrity checks and secure deployment mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中的密码学签名验证不当可导致网络安全功能被绕过，破坏运行时完整性检查和安全部署机制。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in Windows Accessibility Infrastructure permits local privilege escalation, highlighting risks in background system services and helper processes.
items.reason_zh: Windows Accessibility Infrastructure 中的链接解析不当可导致本地权限提升，凸显了后台系统服务和辅助进程的风险。

items.reason_en: Untrusted data deserialization in SQL Server permits unrestricted remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中不受信任数据的反序列化允许无限制的通过网络进行远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Critical SQL Server deserialization flaw enables immediate remote code execution with minimal prerequisites.
items.reason_zh: 关键的 SQL Server 反序列化缺陷仅需极小前提条件即可实现即时远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: External file path control weakness in SQL Server allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges over the network.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的外部文件路径控制弱点允许已认证的攻击者通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: Resource allocation flaw in ASP.NET Core enables remote denial of service attacks against hosted web applications.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的资源分配缺陷可导致针对托管 Web 应用程序的远程拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the SQL Server ODBC driver enables remote code execution over the network, directly compromising database connectivity layers.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server ODBC 驱动程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，直接破坏数据库连接层。

items.reason_en: SQL injection vulnerability in SQL Server allows authenticated attackers to manipulate backend queries, leading to data exfiltration or privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许已认证的攻击者操纵后端查询，导致数据泄露或权限提升。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Azure SQL Database allows unauthorized data manipulation and privilege escalation, directly endangering critical data stores.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许未授权的数据操纵和权限提升，直接危及关键数据存储。

items.reason_en: Improper communication channel restrictions in Azure SQL Managed Instance facilitate man-in-the-middle attacks and unauthorized privilege elevation.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Managed Instance 中的通信通道限制不当助长了中间人攻击和未授权权限提升。

items.reason_en: Adobe ColdFusion's eval injection vulnerability permits low-privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code, undermining application server security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Adobe ColdFusion 的 eval 注入漏洞允许低权限攻击者执行任意代码，破坏应用服务器安全边界。

items.reason_en: MongoDB's case-sensitivity handling flaw can leave the authorization subsystem disabled at startup, exposing unauthenticated network users to unrestricted database operations.
items.reason_zh: MongoDB的大小写处理缺陷可能导致授权子系统在启动时被禁用，使未认证的网络用户能够执行不受限制的数据库操作。

items.reason_en: MongoDB allows authenticated users to craft storage engine parameters that trigger out-of-bounds memory writes, risking server crashes or potential code execution.
items.reason_zh: MongoDB允许已认证用户构造存储引擎参数，触发越界内存写入，可能导致服务器崩溃或潜在代码执行。

items.reason_en: Red Hat's 389-ds-base Cockpit console embeds LDAP distinguished names into shell commands without escaping, enabling delegated directory users to inject system commands.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat的389-ds-base Cockpit控制台在未转义的情况下将LDAP区分名嵌入Shell命令中，使得委派目录用户可注入系统命令。

items.reason_en: SSRF in MindsDB web crawler handler allows fetching internal URLs and bypassing allowlist controls.
items.reason_zh: MindsDB网络爬虫处理器中的SSRF漏洞允许获取内部URL并绕过白名单控制。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in Red Hat Camel-Infinispan allows low-privilege attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Camel-Infinispan中的不安全反序列化漏洞允许低权限攻击者远程执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Incomplete profile validation in Red Hat Dogtag PKI allows CA administrators to exploit external process constraints.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Dogtag PKI中不完整的配置文件验证允许CA管理员利用外部进程约束进行攻击。

items.reason_en: Permits unauthenticated LDAP clients to add OTP tokens due to flawed ACI evaluation, undermining multi-factor authentication controls in FreeIPA.
items.reason_zh: 由于ACI评估存在缺陷，该漏洞允许未认证的LDAP客户端添加OTP令牌，削弱了FreeIPA中的多因素认证控制。

items.reason_en: Causes stale SASL identities to persist across connections after failed binds, leading to authentication bypasses and unauthorized directory access in 389 Directory Server.
items.reason_zh: 导致失败的绑定操作后陈旧SASL身份跨连接持久化，引发389 Directory Server中的身份验证绕过和未授权目录访问。

items.reason_en: Accepts lone LF characters in chunked requests, causing HTTP request smuggling that can bypass WAFs and redirect user traffic in Jetty deployments.
items.reason_zh: 接受分块请求中的孤立LF字符，导致HTTP请求走私，可在Jetty部署中绕过WAF并重定向用户流量。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization enables remote code execution across supported platforms, severely compromising middleware infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 不安全反序列化漏洞支持跨平台远程代码执行，严重破坏中间件基础设施安全。

items.reason_en: Direct OS command injection grants full system compromise on affected middleware installations.
items.reason_zh: 直接OS命令注入可导致受影响的中间件安装环境被完全控制系统。

items.reason_en: Extension design flaw allows privilege escalation from masked database users to root-level code execution.
items.reason_zh: 扩展设计缺陷允许从掩码数据库用户提权至root级别的代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated component registration enables remote code execution in enterprise application servers.
items.reason_zh: 未认证组件注册漏洞可在企业应用服务器中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated requests can extract credentials and manipulate tenant data, breaking multi-tenancy isolation in cloud app frameworks.
items.reason_zh: 未认证请求可提取凭据并操纵租户数据，破坏云应用框架中的多租户隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Erlang's inet packet length calculation corrupts VM memory allocation, potentially leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Erlang的inet数据包长度计算存在整数溢出漏洞，会破坏VM内存分配，可能导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in the Erlang megaco scanner driver allows remote attackers to corrupt memory and achieve arbitrary code execution.
items.reason_zh: Erlang megaco扫描器驱动程序的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者破坏内存并实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Visual Studio via heap overflow impacts developer workstations and CI/CD pipelines, increasing supply chain risk.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio通过堆溢出实现的远程代码执行漏洞影响开发者工作站及CI/CD流水线，增加供应链风险。

items.reason_en: Incomplete input filtering in Visual Studio Code (CVSS 7.8) allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass local security features, potentially leading to unintended code execution or environment manipulation.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code（CVSS 7.8）输入过滤不完整，允许未认证攻击者绕过本地安全功能，可能导致非预期的代码执行或环境篡改。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in Skype for Business (CVSS 8.3) enables unauthenticated spoofing over adjacent networks, undermining communication authenticity and trust.
items.reason_zh: Skype for Business（CVSS 8.3）密码学签名验证不当，允许在相邻网络上进行未认证欺骗，破坏通信的真实性和信任度。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Visual Studio allows remote code execution, compromising developer environments, CI/CD pipelines, and internal build infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio的堆溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及开发环境、CI/CD流水线及内部构建基础设施。

items.reason_en: Credential exposure in the Red Hat Data Science Pipelines Operator leaks sensitive database and object storage keys to unauthenticated attackers, risking data pipeline integrity.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Data Science Pipelines Operator中的凭据泄露漏洞将敏感数据库和对象存储密钥暴露给未认证攻击者，威胁数据管道完整性。

items.reason_en: External control of file paths in Skype for Business enables remote code execution, affecting legacy communication platforms still deployed in certain enterprises.
items.reason_zh: Skype for Business的文件路径外部可控漏洞可实现远程代码执行，影响仍在部分企业部署的遗留通信平台。

items.reason_en: Off-by-one error in GLib can cause out-of-bounds access when parsing key files, potentially leading to application crashes or information leakage in Linux-based systems.
items.reason_zh: GLib中的差一错误在解析密钥文件时可能导致越界访问，进而引发基于Linux的系统应用程序崩溃或信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Link resolution flaw in Microsoft PC Manager enables local privilege escalation, compromising system maintenance utilities and endpoint management tools.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft PC Manager的链接解析缺陷可导致本地提权，危及系统维护工具和终端管理工具。

items.reason_en: Inadequate file naming restrictions in Github Copilot allow local code execution, posing direct risks to developer environments and CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Github Copilot的文件命名限制不足允许本地代码执行，对开发环境和CI/CD流水线构成直接风险。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Windows Narrator Braille allows local privilege escalation, demonstrating broader input validation gaps in system utility components.
items.reason_zh: Windows Narrator Braille中的OS命令注入漏洞允许本地提权，反映出系统实用程序组件中存在更广泛的输入验证缺陷。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in Windows PC Manager permits local privilege escalation, posing risks to system optimization and management software.
items.reason_zh: Windows PC Manager的不当链接解析允许本地提权，对系统优化和管理软件构成风险。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in the Windows MIDI Service Module allows local privilege escalation, revealing privilege boundary failures in multimedia subsystems.
items.reason_zh: Windows MIDI Service Module的不当访问控制允许本地提权，暴露出多媒体子系统中的权限边界失效问题。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Visual Studio Code allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands over the network.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中的OS命令注入漏洞允许远程攻击者在网络上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Microsoft Defender enables local code execution by unprivileged users on endpoint systems.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Defender中的整数溢出漏洞允许无特权用户在终端系统上执行本地代码。

items.reason_en: Type validation weakness in the .NET Framework permits remote denial of service attacks against dependent applications.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework中的类型验证缺陷允许对依赖应用程序发起远程拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Exchange Server facilitates remote code execution over the network, impacting email infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的堆溢出漏洞可实现在网络上的远程代码执行，影响电子邮件基础设施。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in Age of Empires II allows remote code execution over the network, creating an unexpected attack surface in gaming clients.
items.reason_zh: Age of Empires II中的相对路径遍历漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，在游戏客户端中引入了意外的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Windows Terminal enables remote code execution over the network, potentially affecting system administration and developer workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows Terminal中的整数溢出漏洞可实现在网络上的远程代码执行，可能影响系统管理和开发者工作流。

items.reason_en: URL parameter manipulation in IBM Quarkus bypasses authorization controls, risking unauthorized access to backend microservices.
items.reason_zh: IBM Quarkus中的URL参数操纵可绕过授权控制，导致后端微服务面临未授权访问风险。

items.reason_en: Command injection in OP5 Monitor allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary shell commands, compromising network monitoring infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: OP5 Monitor中的命令注入漏洞允许已认证用户执行任意Shell命令，从而破坏网络监控基础设施。

items.reason_en: Roo-Code IDE extension contains a shell command approval bypass that exploits parser mismatches, allowing attackers to execute denied commands in development environments.
items.reason_zh: Roo-Code IDE扩展程序存在Shell命令审批绕过漏洞，该漏洞利用解析器不匹配问题，使攻击者能够在开发环境中执行被禁止的命令。

items.reason_en: Axolotl AI platform defaults to trusting remote code in Hugging Face models, enabling attackers to execute arbitrary Python code when loading compromised repositories.
items.reason_zh: Axolotl AI平台默认信任Hugging Face模型中的远程代码，攻击者在加载受损仓库时可执行任意Python代码。

items.reason_en: MLflow's artifact loading mechanism executes arbitrary code from maliciously crafted model packages, posing a significant supply chain risk for machine learning workflows.
items.reason_zh: MLflow的工件加载机制会执行恶意构造的模型包中的任意代码，为机器学习工作流带来严重的供应链风险。

items.reason_en: Bifrost HTTP transport accepts unauthenticated custom plugins via HTTP URLs, allowing attackers to download and load shared-object libraries for remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Bifrost HTTP传输层通过HTTP URL接受未经身份验证的自定义插件，允许攻击者下载并加载共享对象库以执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Kernel race condition in POSIX CPU timers can cause use-after-free issues and is already exploited in the wild.
items.reason_zh: POSIX CPU计时器的内核竞态条件可能导致释放后使用漏洞，且已在现实中被实际利用。

items.reason_en: Unquoted shell variables in Red Hat dracut initramfs hooks allow DHCP-controlled attackers to inject commands.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat dracut initramfs钩子中的未加引号Shell变量允许受DHCP控制的攻击者注入命令。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Samsung Walrus allows buffer overflow exploitation in collaboration software.
items.reason_zh: Samsung Walrus中的越界写入漏洞可导致协作软件发生缓冲区溢出利用。

items.reason_en: A critical memory safety flaw in SAP's Extended Passport Protocol library that could lead to undefined behavior or denial of service from malformed network packets.
items.reason_zh: SAP的Extended Passport Protocol库中存在关键内存安全缺陷，畸形网络数据包可能导致未定义行为或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: CPU microarchitecture flaw allows instruction corruption via improper operation cache sharing, requiring firmware mitigation.
items.reason_zh: CPU微架构缺陷允许通过不当的操作缓存共享导致指令损坏，需通过固件更新进行缓解。

items.reason_en: Race condition during process execution causes use-after-free, potentially leading to local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: 进程执行期间的竞态条件会导致释放后使用漏洞，可能引发本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Race condition in process tracing access checks can lead to deadlocks or security bypasses in containerized environments.
items.reason_zh: 进程跟踪访问检查中的竞态条件可能导致容器化环境中的死锁或安全绕过。

items.reason_en: Preemption during fatal exception handling can cause scheduler corruption and system hangs.
items.reason_zh: 致命异常处理期间的抢占可能导致调度器损坏和系统挂起。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited cryptographic module flaw forces unsafe in-place AEAD operations, leading to memory corruption and data integrity violations in production systems.
items.reason_zh: 正被积极利用的密码学模块缺陷强制执行不安全的就地AEAD操作，导致生产系统中的内存损坏和数据完整性违规。

items.reason_en: Configurable dentry hash table parameters trigger out-of-bounds reads in the kernel, allowing local users to leak sensitive memory contents.
items.reason_zh: 可配置的dentry哈希表参数会在内核中触发越界读取，使本地用户能够泄露敏感内存内容。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in the stmmac driver's jumbo frame chain mode causes buffer over-reads during packet processing, destabilizing network performance.
items.reason_zh: stmmac驱动程序的巨型帧链模式中的整数下溢在数据包处理期间会导致缓冲区越界读取，破坏网络性能稳定性。

items.reason_en: Race condition in NVMe-FC controller teardown leaves work queues dangling, enabling use-after-free exploits targeting storage subsystems.
items.reason_zh: NVMe-FC控制器拆除过程中的竞态条件会导致工作队列悬空，使针对存储子系统的释放后使用漏洞利用成为可能。

items.reason_en: Concurrency race in futex requeue-PI logic triggers use-after-free conditions, impacting process scheduling and enabling local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: futex重排队列-PI逻辑中的并发竞态条件会触发释放后使用漏洞，影响进程调度并实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free during VFS writeback operations corrupts inode metadata, frequently causing kernel panics under heavy disk I/O loads.
items.reason_zh: VFS回写操作期间的释放后使用漏洞会损坏inode元数据，在重磁盘I/O负载下频繁引发内核恐慌。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Linux NFS ACL handling can lead to kernel crashes or privilege escalation when processing malformed access controls.
items.reason_zh: Linux NFS ACL处理中的释放后使用漏洞在处理畸形访问控制时可能导致内核崩溃或权限提升。

items.reason_en: Inadequate path validation in the Gleam compiler permits arbitrary filesystem writes during Git dependency resolution, compromising build environments.
items.reason_zh: Gleam编译器中的路径验证不足允许在Git依赖解析期间进行任意文件系统写入，破坏构建环境。

items.reason_en: Reflected cross-site scripting in Siemens Teamcenter allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into enterprise PLM workflows.
items.reason_zh: Siemens Teamcenter中的反射型跨站脚本漏洞允许攻击者将恶意脚本注入企业PLM工作流。
